headline.title: We searched "dental implants Edinburgh". Edinburgh Dental Specialists appeared in none of the 16 results.
headline.detail: New Life Teeth appeared twice, and 103 Dental, Seven Hills Dental and mydentist also showed, along with WhatClinic and medical-tourism directories. Patients who have trusted you with implants since 2006 can find you; new ones searching today mostly can't.

summary: Edinburgh Dental Specialists has 382 reviews at 4.8, with patients describing specialist care explained in plain words and aftercare that is second to none. But when we searched for dental implants in Edinburgh, your practice didn't appear, while implant-focused clinics and directories took the page.

search.result: WhatClinic (twice), New Life Teeth (twice), mydentist, Seven Hills Dental, 103 Dental, medical-tourism platforms and a quote site. Edinburgh Dental Specialists did not appear in the 16 results.
search.meaning: People researching implants, a high-value treatment, meet other clinics and directories first.

visibility: In our search for dental implants in Edinburgh, your practice did not appear. Implant-focused clinics and directories filled the page.
lead: 382 reviews at 4.8, many from long-term implant patients (some since 2006).
Genuine specialists: implants, oral surgery, restorative and paediatric care in one practice.
Reviews praise plain-language explanations, written treatment plans and outstanding aftercare.
lose: A clinic in Newington has 907 reviews and appointments until 7pm two evenings a week.
Implant-focused clinics appear in search; you don't.
Closed at 5pm every weekday, so working patients compare evening options elsewhere.

gaps.title: Implant searchers never meet the specialists
gaps.detail: People comparing implant clinics see directories and implant chains first, and never learn a specialist practice is on Rose Street.

gaps.title: Referrals depend on other dentists
gaps.detail: Specialist practices that rely on referrals miss the growing number of patients who research and choose for themselves.

gaps.title: Your aftercare story is hidden
gaps.detail: Reviews describe written plans and second-to-none aftercare, a strong reason to choose you, but people searching don't see it.

actions.title: Give implants and oral surgery their own pages
actions.why: Implant patients research for weeks; a clear specialist page with your long-term results wins that research.

actions.title: Ask every patient for a review automatically
actions.why: Closing the gap with the 907-review clinic matters most for high-value treatments.

actions.title: Show your written plans and aftercare up front
actions.why: Doable today: it's what reviews praise most and what implant patients worry about.

plan.title: Your new website with booking built in
plan.detail: Your team, specialties and reviews on one page, with one-tap booking from any phone.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each visit, so happy patients become five-star reviews.

plan.title: Reminders and recall
plan.detail: Follow-up and maintenance reminders that go out by themselves.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Where you stand against nearby clinics, and what to do next.

scenario: A 58-year-old in Stockbridge loses a front tooth and starts researching implants. On Sunday evening she searches "dental implants Edinburgh", reads a directory and an implant chain's page, and books a consultation there. The specialists on Rose Street, ten minutes away, never appear. (Illustration.)
nochange: Your existing patients and referrals keep coming. New patients researching implants keep choosing the clinics they find first.
